template.gloss_en: The neighbouring warehouse has {T} tyres. Our warehouse has {M} tyres. They are kept at {S} tyres per rack. If all the tyres in our warehouse were stacked on racks, how many racks would fill up?
template.notes: Conditional form. Group size division: S is tyres per rack, M is our warehouse's total. T is the neighbouring warehouse's total. Extra sentences: a marking number on a door; a warehouse in a distant city.
